requirements.requirement: FPGA implements native25 RoCEv2 transport and interoperates with the actual CX455A hardware RNIC
requirements.scope: Experimental IPv4 RC WRITE_ONLY initiator from bounded FPGA-local pattern, not a full verbs provider

requirements.requirement: Actual RDMA registered-memory contents, protocol state, acknowledgement/completion and error behavior verified
checks: Every byte in distinct receiver ranges; zero mismatches
65-byte tail and 24-bit PSN wrap; queued16384-WRITE case

10ms controller ERROR2 with zero ACKs, then normal acknowledged WRITE without NIC reset or programming

requirements.requirement: Finite large-transfer payload performance on25G demonstrated; not inferred from link speed/TCP/simulation/single packet
FPGA is not replaced by a software RoCE endpoint during native completion audit
Source/dependency/build/programming identities and measurements distinguish tested artifacts from variants
Finite supervised tests preserve SRAM-only/BIOS Medium/management and unrelated-device constraints
